description: Shared correctness fixtures for the five layout variants (natural, poorFieldOrder, optimizedFieldOrder, cacheLineAligned, packedUnaligned) over three datasets. Field order and alignment change bytes/record and ns/access, never the checksum (mixedPrimitiveRecord, headerPlusPayload) or the final counts (producerConsumerCounters).

semantics.xorshift64: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 7 (unsigned/logical); x ^= x << 17 (64-bit wrapping, unsigned interpretation throughout)

mixedPrimitiveRecord.fields: active = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 2 (1 byte); category = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 16 (1 byte); quantity = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 100,000 (4 bytes); flags = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000 (2 bytes); amountTicks = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 10,000,000 (8 bytes); timestamp = i (linear, 8 bytes) — per record, five xorshift64 advances in this order: active, category, quantity, flags, amountTicks
mixedPrimitiveRecord.checksum: wrapping sum of (active + timestamp + category + quantity + flags + amountTicks) over all records

headerPlusPayload.fields: msgType = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 8 (1 byte); msgFlags = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 256 (1 byte); sequence = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000 (4 bytes); payload = 8 longs, xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000 each (64 bytes) — per record, one advance each for msgType/msgFlags/sequence then eight more for payload[0..8)
headerPlusPayload.checksum: wrapping sum of (msgType + msgFlags + sequence + sum(payload)) over all records

producerConsumerCounters.oracle: two threads, each incrementing only its OWN counter field exactly incrementsPerThread times; after both threads join, producerCount == incrementsPerThread AND consumerCount == incrementsPerThread, for every layout variant — layout changes coherence traffic and throughput, never the final counts (this dataset has no summed checksum; its oracle is the exact final count pair)
